entries.en: Curious Gorge has been training as hard as ever and has indeed grown stronger for it, yet upon seeing you for the first time in an age, he immediately recognizes that you have grown stronger still. After you regale him with tales of your adventures in the First, particularly those of Granson and Dikaiosyne, he concludes that the reason for his limited growth is love─or rather, that he has been unable to put it out of his mind. Curious Gorge has sent many missives to Dorgono in the Far East, but has yet to receive even a single reply, and so he resolves to go and see her in person...and thus is not present when Dorgono and her father Luvsan arrive moments later, having recently come all the way from the Azim Steppe to thank in person all those who aided the Qerel. Since Curious Gorge is nowhere to be found, you are to proceed to the Moraby Drydocks where Broken Mountain and his warriors can be found.
entries.fr: Curious Gorge a pris le chemin de la Steppe d'Azim pour rejoindre Dorgono, mais celle-ci vous a retrouvé à la Chute cachée. Elle était venue avec son père, l'ancien de la tribu des Qerel, qui souhaitait vous remercier pour votre victoire sur les Chagan. Vous avez ensuite accepté d'accompagner père et fille jusqu'au chantier naval de Moraby, afin qu'ils puissent remercier les soldats du Maelstrom. Allez parler à Broken Mountain.

前回までの冒険録：
キュリアス・ゴージは、アジムステップから来たドルゴノに恋に落ちたことで、不調をきたしてしまう。しかし、自分の気持ちを認めることで彼は復活し、冒険者とともにドルゴノの部族の仇敵を討ち果たす。両想いとなったキュリアス・ゴージとドルゴノは、再会を誓って家路につくのだった。
　　　　　　　　　　　　*　*　*
キュリアス・ゴージは、ドルゴノに会いにアジムステップへ向かったが、その直後にドルゴノが現れた。ケレル族の長老であり、ドルゴノの父であるルヴサンから前回の礼を言われた。彼は戦士隊にも礼を言いたいというので、付き合うことになった。低地ラノシアのモラビー造船廠で「ブロークン・マウンテン」と話そう。

entries.en: During the course of their conversation, Broken Mountain admits to Luvsan that he does not carry an axe because he can no longer fight. However, the elder Xaela does not believe all hope is lost, and proposes a treatment that may restore him to fighting condition. A certain type of moss will be necessary for this, and Luvsan believes he saw a suitable substitute on the way to the docks.
entries.fr: Luvsan, dont le cadeau de cinquante bouquetins n'a pas eu l'effet escompté, a finalement décidé de remercier Broken Moutain en le guérissant de son ancienne blessure qui l'empêche de se battre. Discutez avec Luvsan pour savoir comment il compte s'y prendre.

After meeting you, he concludes that you are the suitor in question, and offers to bless your union─at which point Dorgono returns and puts an end to the discussion for the time being.

entries.en: With all gathered for the ritual, Luvsan offers an elixir to Broken Mountain, who drinks deep. Finally, he instructs you to strike the injured warrior with all your might, assuring you both that it is the only way. Though Broken Mountain is understandably uncomfortable with this proposal, the die is cast, and only a Heavy Swing will suffice.
entries.fr: Luvsan vous a expliqué que pour guérir Broken Moutain, il faut que vous le frappiez de toutes vos forces. Assénez un coup puissant au frère de Curious Gorge.

entries.en:
Broken Mountain weathers your assault, and moments later finds himself filled with newfound strength. He is a warrior reborn, and the beast within is his to command. As all celebrate his successful recovery, Curious Gorge approaches─but observing from afar, mistakes Dorgono's joyful smile as an expression of her love towards you, leading him to succumb to his inner beast and charge. Fortunately, before it turns into a needlessly messy and violent affair, she brings him to his senses with a single blow.

After Curious Gorge recovers, he apologizes for the misunderstanding, and joins in celebrating his brother's miraculous recovery. Sensing that this is the Western suitor, Luvsan silently approves, and declares that it is time to return to the Steppe─alone. Dorgono, however, is to remain in Eorzea, where she will continue to hone her skills until she is a warrior fit to be wed. Needless to say, both she and Curious Gorge are more than satisfied with this state of affairs, and together they return to Hidden Falls to begin their training together.

Luvsan, ayant accompli ce qu'il était venu faire, a décidé de rentrer dans son village, en laissant sa fille sur place pour qu'elle continue son entraînement. Allez retrouver Curious Gorge à la Chute cachée.

entries.en: No matter how many he sent, I would have never responded. Our people have no written tongue. Whatever reached us was probably fed to the goats. Anyway─let us hope that someone informs him of our arrival before he gets on a ship...
entries.fr: J'ai reçu sa lettre, mais on sait pas lire, nous autres Qerel... Les bouquetins ont bien apprécié la mâchouiller par contre... Bon, c'est pas grave, il est pas parti pour toujours, va.
entries.ja:
手紙なんかよこされても、
文字のねえオラの部族じゃ、山羊に食われるだけだ。
まあ、そのうち戻ってくるだろうし、放っておこうぜ。

entries.en: As for why I have traveled all this way, it was at the behest of my father, who wished to thank you and Curious Gorge personally for fighting on our behalf.
entries.fr: Le plus ironique dans tout ça c'est que l'ancien de mon village m'a précisément donné comme mission de venir en Éorzéa et de vous ramener chez nous avec Gorge ! C'est pour ça que je suis ici !
entries.ja:
今回、エオルゼアに来たのは、ほかでもねえ……
部族のために戦ってくれた、オメとゴージに、
長老がどうしても礼を伝えたいというんで、連れてきたんだ。

entries.fr: Bonjour,  aventuri, je m'appelle Luvsan. C'est donc vous que je dois remercier pour nous avoir débarassés des Chagan.

ケレル族の長老、ルヴサンと申します。
わが部族のために、チャガン族を倒してくれたこと……

entries.en: But that is not all, for you also helped my youngest daughter gain control over the will of Karash. No words can express the depth of my gratitude to you.
entries.fr: Ma fille m'a également rapporté que vous l'aviez aidée à vaincre sa bête intérieure. Je ne sais comment vous remercier.
entries.ja:
そして、わが末娘、ドルゴノの面倒を見てもらい、
「悪鬼憑き」まで治してくださったこと、深く感謝します。

entries.en: You promised not to speak of Karash...
entries.fr: On avait dit qu'on parlait pas de notre lien de parenté !
entries.ja: それは、言わねえ約束だろうが……。

entries.en: But I must. My heart broke when she was marked as Taken and exiled. Never again would I see her, I feared. But then she returned! Blood of my blood, master of Karash! My little girl...and it is all because of you.
entries.fr: Devoir interdire à ma fille de revenir parmi nous fut la décision la plus difficile que j'aie eu à prendre de toute ma vie. Mais grâce à vous, Dorgono ne pose plus aucun danger, et a pu revenir vivre au village.

部族を護るためとはいえ、娘を追放するのは断腸の思いでしたが、
あなたのおかげで、ドルゴノは戻ることができた。
本当にありがとうございました。

それでは次は、お前が身を置いていたという、
黒渦団の戦士隊のもとに、お礼に向かおう。

entries.fr: Nous ne voyons pas souvent de guerriers aussi doués que Dorgono ! Même si son séjour parmi nous fut très bref, elle nous a été d'une très grande aide !

こちらこそ、短い間ではありましたが、
ドルゴノには戦士隊で大きな戦力になってもらいました。
できれば、また復帰してもらいたいくらいですよ。

entries.en: That is...that is because I cannot. Not since I was defeated by mine own brother in battle. He had succumbed to his inner beast─your Karash─and struck a blow with such ferocity from which I have never fully recovered.
entries.fr: Eh bien, c'est parce qu'il y a longtemps j'ai perdu un combat contre mon frère qui était sous l'emprise de sa bête intérieure... Ou possédé par un esprit malin, si vous préférez.

実は……私はかつて「原初の魂」に飲まれた弟……
おっと、そちらでは「悪鬼憑き」と呼ぶのでしたな。
その状態に陥った我が弟に、手ひどくやられまして……。
